        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);
            double a1r = (realPart[i] + realPart[j]) / 2;
            double a1i = (imagPart[i] - imagPart[j]) / 2;
            double a2r = (imagPart[i] + imagPart[j]) / 2;
            double a2i = (realPart[j] - realPart[i]) / 2;
            double b1r = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) / 2;
            double b1i = (bImag[i] - bImag[j]) / 2;
            double b2r = (bImag[i] + bImag[j]) / 2;
            double b2i = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) / 2;
            faReal[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
            faImag[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
            fbReal[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
            fbImag[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
        }
        fftTransform(faReal, faImag, true);
        fftTransform(fbReal, fbImag, true);
        int[] res = new int[need];
        for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
            long aa = (long) (faReal[i] + 0.5);
            long bb = (long) (fbReal[i] + 0.5);
            long cc = (long) (faImaginary[i] + 0.5);
            res[i] = (int) ((aa + (bb << 15) + (cc << 30)) % mod);
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void fftTransform(double[] real, double[] imag, boolean inverse) {
        int n = real.length;
        int j = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int bit = n >> 1;
            while (j >= bit) {
                j -= bit;
                bit >>= 1;
            }
            j += bit;
            if (i < j) {
                double tmpR = real[i];
                double tmpI = imag[i];
                real[i] = real[j];
                imag[i] = imag[j];
                real[j] = tmpR;
                imag[j] = tmpI;
            }
        }
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            double angle = 2 * Math.PI / len * (inverse ? -1 : 1);
            double wlenR = Math.cos(angle);
            double wlenI = Math.sin(angle);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                double wR = 1;
                double wI = 0;
                for (int j2 = 0; j2 < len / 2; j2++) {
                    int pos = i + j2;
                    int pos2 = i + j2 + len / 2;
                    double uR = real[pos];
                    double uI = imag[pos];
                    double vR = real[pos2] * wR - imag[pos2] * wI;
                    double vI = real[pos2] * wI + imag[pos2] * wR;
                    real[pos] = uR + vR;
                    imag[pos] = uI + vI;
                    real[pos2] = uR - vR;
                    imag[pos2] = uI - vI;
                    double nextW = wR * wlenR - wI * wlenI;
                    wI = wR * wlenI + wI * wlenR;
                    wR = nextW;
                }
            }
        }
        if (inverse) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                real[i] /= n;
                imag[i] /= n;
            }
        }
    }
